lessons.title: Lessons (newest first, keep under 30 lines; prune stale ones)
items: 2026-10-16: Week 10/12–16 scorecard: 9 up / 4 down / 3 flat while SPY −2%. Defensive swing ideas (BLK, UNH, XLV) beat the tape during the AI/chip rout.
2026-10-16: Re-affirming a winner after a big multi-day run (UNH 10/15 close, 10/16 open) bought the top; once a name is +5% in a week, hold it but don't re-add.
2026-10-16: A swing "long" on a crowded AI theme (LITE, ASML) failed fast when the sector cracked; when a group is in avoid, pull open swing ideas in it the same day.
2026-10-16: Grade swing calls mark-to-market each Friday from the actual entry (open for pre-market calls, close for close calls); keep "open" until horizon ends.
2026-10-09: Sector shocks need whole-group avoids — SpaceX spectrum crush on T/VZ/TMUS validated bundling telcos; towers (AMT/CCI) were the correct long read-through (still +2–3%).
2026-10-09: Gappers +10% often fade from the open but can win close-to-close; grade both.
2026-10-09: Oil-premium swings (XOM) reverse fast on de-escalation headlines; keep confidence low and horizon honest.
Keep briefs short and ranked by expected impact; Tendies and Dip needs decisions, not volume.
Every claim needs a source link and a timestamp; never guess prices.

note.text:
RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-10-16)
The AI-debt and chip selloff resumed into opex: S&P -1.1%, Nasdaq -2.1%, and chips fell an eighth straight day (SOXX -4.1%, AMD -6%, MU -5.6%, CoreWeave -12%). VIX jumped to about 20. It was the Nasdaq's worst week since June, while the Dow held a weekly gain.
Brent touched $110 as Iran escalated in the Strait of Hormuz. Energy (XLE +2.5%), staples and utilities led; airlines sank again (UAL -5%), so the airline avoid stays.
Our ideas: BLK +1.2% and WMT +0.8% today; UNH slipped 1.3% but is still up about 6% on the week. Avoids were right again on optics (COHR -7%, CIEN -7%, LITE -5%), CoreWeave and Oracle.
Weekly hit rate: 9 of 16 calls up, 4 down, 3 flat, led by BLK, UNH and XLV while SPY fell 2%. Misses were ASML and the late UNH re-adds.
Next week: NFLX 10/20 after close; TSLA, IBM and META 10/21; AAL 10/22; FOMC 10/28. Watch weekend oil headlines and whether chips find a floor. Stay defensive-tilted and swing long-only.
